items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: he also loved Little Jazz Roy Eldridge

ctx.x: To continue, and finally wrap up Charlie Shavers, I was getting to the point where I was talking about his being accepted -- I don't think he was accepted to the fullest of his greatness. Oh, he was loved by the multitudes, but I don't think he ever reached the epitome in life that he might have, had he lived longer.

Charlie loved Louis Armstrong, of course -- these are the little things that I know, and he also loved Little Jazz Roy Eldridge, he used to carry records of Roy when he was with Gene Krupa, around the room, and enjoyed them so much.

Also, Charlie Ventura, because Charlie was also on those records, and he used to play them for me. However, God will watch over Charlie Shavers in heaven, I know, and he'll be up there swapping beautiful lies with Ben Webster. I guess he always called Ben Webster 'frog' -- Ben was also called that in the Ellington band, too, with his bulging eyes, he gave that impression.
